entries.wording: la spedizione è stata presa in carico presso il Punto Poste
entries.note: Prefix match, checked before the shorter prefix: a drop-off at a Punto Poste.

entries.wording: la spedizione è stata presa in carico da un nostro operatore…
entries.note: Prefix match, checked before the shorter prefix: taken in at a post office counter or from the sender's home.

entries.wording: la spedizione è stata presa in carico…
entries.note: Prefix match, after the Punto Poste and operator prefixes: the bare line names no intake.

entries.wording: da un nostro operatore presso…
entries.note: Prefix match: the operator's intake on its own line.

entries.wording: Presa in carico da un nostro operatore…
entries.note: Prefix match: registered mail's intake, the box 2 fragment after the official page's label for that box.

entries.wording: Presa in carico a seguito di acquisto da poste.it
entries.note: Exact match: an online purchase, the box 2 fragment after the page's label; it names no intake.

entries.wording: a seguito di acquisto da poste.it
entries.note: Exact match.

entries.wording: la spedizione è in transito…
entries.note: Prefix match.

entries.wording: completata la fase di verifica per lo svincolo…
entries.note: Customs release; prefix match.

entries.wording: all’estero
entries.note: Exact match; the ASCII apostrophe variant is accepted too.

entries.wording: presso il paese estero in data
entries.note: Exact match.

entries.wording: in data
entries.note: Exact match on a truncated movement line.

entries.wording: In transito
entries.note: Exact match: registered mail's box 3 "in data" under the page's label for that box.

entries.wording: In transito presso il paese estero
entries.note: Exact match: a prior-art fragment under box 3's label, as is "In transito all’estero".

entries.wording: In consegna
entries.note: Exact match: registered mail's box 4 "in data" under the page's label for that box.

entries.wording: cambio disposizioni di consegna
entries.note: Exact match: a change to the delivery instructions, after which the parcel carries on.

entries.wording: la spedizione è in consegna
entries.note: Exact match.

entries.wording: la spedizione sarà disponibile per il ritiro presso l'Ufficio Postale a partire dal…
entries.note: Prefix match: registered mail held at a post office from the date the line gives.

entries.wording: disponibile per il ritiro dal giorno lavorativo successivo alla data indicata
entries.note: Exact match.

entries.wording: disponibile per il ritiro entro i termini indicati su SMS/email
entries.note: Exact match: a parcel left at a PuntoPoste or locker, to collect within the time the notice gives.

entries.wording: la spedizione è stata consegnata
entries.note: Exact match.

entries.wording: la spedizione e' stata consegnata
entries.note: ASCII-apostrophe variant observed live on a delivered parcel.

entries.wording: con successo in data
entries.note: Exact match on a truncated delivery line.

entries.wording: Consegnata con successo
entries.note: Exact match: registered mail's box 5 fragment after the page's label for that box.

entries.wording: consegna non andata a buon fine…
entries.note: Prefix match; seen live with a wrong or incomplete recipient address.

entries.wording: non è stato possibile effettuare la consegna…
entries.note: Prefix match: a failed round, with the working day the next round starts from.

entries.wording: sono in corso delle verifiche sulla spedizione. contatta assistenza
entries.note: Exact match.

entries.wording: in restituzione al mittente…
entries.note: Prefix match. Movements from here on carry the return flag, and the final delivery is the one to the sender.
Envelope-level `stato`, not an event code: it forces delivered regardless of the movement wording, or returned when that delivery carries the return flag.
